Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/swapped the directors’ birth years. The sources showed David Butler born in 1894 and Lambert Hillyer born in 1893, but the Planner stated Butler as 1893 and Hillyer as 1894, leading to the incorrect conclusion that The Whistle’s director was born later instead of The Daughter of Rosie O’Grady.
